mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. It is 80 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park. We are in a third quarter moon phase tonight, and early tomorrow at 3:35 AM, you can spot the ISS rising in the Northwest over Verona High School and traveling toward the East over Fitchburg, reaching about halfway up the sky. The low tonight will be 73 degrees with rain expected.

There are two major updates for our city. First, the City is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round accessibility, including replacing bridges. Second, a new public art installation called Tai Chi Animal Frolics has been unveiled at Century School Park, featuring animal-inspired movements carved from a reclaimed ash tree.

We have a busy schedule for our community. Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or play trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding the weekly safety report, on August 30, officers responded to a witness report of a vehicle window being intentionally smashed on North Edge Trail; the suspect fled the scene and an arrest warrant has been issued.
Today's flavor is Snickers Swirl, and the team at Culver's is ready to serve you until they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
